Name: (CP) Just Junior
Author: eisenbuns
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Renames Abigail's pet guinea pig to simply "Junior".

This is a very niche mod, but one that I wanted to make. My late father's name was David, and I wanted to create this mod for myself (and others) so I wasn't confronted with that name every time I interacted with my in-game wife. I hope this helps someone else!

Should replace any references to "David" the guinea pig, including the item description inside Abigail's room. If you run into any instances of dialogue I've missed, please let me know. 

I've never modded anything before, so please do comment if you run into any issues and I'll do my best to troubleshoot.

VANILLA TESTED ONLY - Not compatible with any dialogue expansion mods at this time, but if you'd like this, I'm open to exploring that with permission from those mod authors.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "JustJunior CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy no more references to "David" the guinea pig!

Manifest.Name: Just Junior
Manifest.Description: Changes the name of Abigail's pet guinea pig.
